name: Tajime Gomei
about: Tajime Gomei is a sake brewery in Yanase-cho, Sando, in the city of Asago in Hyogo, and it sells its sake as Chikusen. The name joins take, bamboo, from the clear Maruyama River, with izumi, from Izumi province, where the founding family came from, the village of Kunidajime.
A junmai from the brewery, made with sake rice grown in Asago, won gold at the Kura Master competition in France four years running to 2020. The company is a limited partnership, 田治米合名会社.
